measurements.basis: ABSOLUTE. Integrated area of the calibrated total-photon-flux spectrum divided by 2.26 x 10^11 luciferin molecules, on the Ando-type integrating spectrometer rebuilt with a higher-full-well CCD (Spec-10:400BR, liquid-nitrogen cooled to -120 degC) and an independent recalibration; the quoted +/-7.2 percentage points is the 15 % (k = 1) calibration uncertainty applied to 47.6 %. Calibration chain: light-collection efficiency of the cell 0.279 % +/- 0.015 %, slit transmissivity 5.74 % +/- 0.08 %, absolute sensitivity 19.6 +/- 1.7 photons per count; replacing the power meter with an AIST-calibrated photodiode cut the power-measurement uncertainty from 5 % to 0.9 % (this is why Wang's 15 % is smaller than Ando's 18 %)

measurements.value_reported: metal-ion dependence at pH 8.0: essentially constant (ca. 45-50 %) for Mg2+, Ca2+ and Mn2+ over 0.01-10 mM; below 10 % with 3 mM Zn2+ or Cd2+; still above 20 % with equal (ca. 3 mM) amounts of Ni2+, Co2+ or Fe2+; below 5 % with only 2.5 x 10^-5 M Hg2+. Half-maximal quenching needs about 1 mM Zn2+ or Cd2+, or about 4 mM Ni2+, Co2+ or Fe2+
